rationale: The DPR explicitly says both confined and unconfined bubble curtains were tested. Activity 1055 covers unconfined; 1065 covers confined and was omitted.
The DPR explicitly reports mobilizing to Site A and installing pile A-1. Both matching schedule activities were proposed.

The DPR reports initial mobilization/movement to Site A, installation of A-1, and work with the unconfined curtain. ID 1050 is the applicable move-to-A activity at this stage; 1130 is the later return to A after Location B. Structure survey and dynamic pile testing have no distinct activities in this 27-activity schedule.

The DPR explicitly reports installing pile A-3 and installing the unconfined curtain system. The schedule represents that curtain work under activity 1055 TEST UNCONFINED BUBBLE CURTAIN; survey and dynamic testing have no separate schedule activities.
The DPR explicitly reports installation of test pile A-3; activity 1080 is an exact identity match.
The DPR reports restriking A-1, removing an A-location pile, and installing A-2. All three matching schedule activities were proposed; survey and dynamic testing have no separate schedule activities.
The DPR reports restriking A-3, attempting removal of A-3, and installing A-4. The failed extraction attempt is still work under the A-location pile-removal activity.

The DPR reports installing B-2 and installing the confined bubble-curtain system. The schedule represents the confined-curtain work under activity 1065 TEST CONFINED BUBBLE CURTAIN; survey and dynamic testing have no separate activities.
The DPR explicitly reports both moving the barge to the Washington/Location B side and installing B-2. Activity 1100 MOVE TO LOCATION B was omitted.
The DPR reports installing B-1, confined-curtain work, restriking A-2, moving from B back to A, and removing A-2. Activity 1130 MOVE TO LOCATION A was omitted.

The DPR reports installing B-1 and moving the barge to the Oregon/Location A side. It states that restrikes and removal are the purpose of the move, not necessarily completed in this summary, so only the move activity 1130 is added.
The DPR explicitly reports removal of A-location piles and a restrike of A-4. Both matching activities were proposed.
The DPR explicitly reports restriking both B-2 and B-1 and removing both. Activity 1200 RESTRIKE PILE B-1 was omitted.
